title: Mary Hubbard takes the Alliance presidency
summary: Mary Hubbard announces her presidency of the Open Website Alliance, representing the WordPress Foundation in the role that rotates among members.

title: TYPO3 outlines FAIR collaboration at CloudFest
summary: Ahead of CloudFest, TYPO3 outlined plans to work with other open-source contributors on FAIR protocol support, connecting the proposal to its work within the Alliance.

title: CMS communities meet on the Cyber Resilience Act
summary: Joomla reports on the Alliance’s October 10, 2025 workshop in Vienna, where CMS representatives came together to discuss the Cyber Resilience Act.

title: TYPO3’s turn in the rotating presidency
summary: TYPO3 looks at Olivier Dobberkau’s presidency, which began in February 2025, and the cross-community collaboration and regulatory work on his agenda.

title: The Open Website Alliance is announced
summary: The community organizations behind Drupal, Joomla, TYPO3 and WordPress announce an alliance to promote open-source software and collaborate across their projects.

title: Before the Alliance: a joint letter to EU legislators
summary: Drupal, Joomla, TYPO3 and WordPress jointly raise concerns about the proposed Cyber Resilience Act. This collaboration preceded the Alliance’s formation.
